comment: Advisories the audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) tolerates, and only
because no upstream fix exists yet. Every entry must be dev-only, must
carry an expiry, and is re-checked on each run: the gate fails if an
entry expires, if the advisory starts affecting a production dependency,
or if it stops matching (upstream shipped a fix — delete the entry).
This file is not a way to silence a fixable finding. If `npm audit` can
resolve it with an override or an upgrade, do that instead.

allow.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested brace patterns (published 2026-09-18). No patched release exists: the advisory covers braces <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest version. Our only path is eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob 3.3.1 -> micromatch 4.0.8 -> braces 3.0.3, i.e. lint-time globbing over our own repo's file patterns, never shipped to users and never fed untrusted input. Delete this entry when braces ships a fix (the gate fails once it stops matching).
